trap-rhetorical-pivot.evidence: Read in full (prose, one tikzcd, three displays, a three-item gloss list, and a closing note-on-counting section). Judged all ten categories in context.
trap-rhetorical-pivot.notes: STRUCTURAL DEFECTS reported, not fixed: (1) BUILD-FATAL -- one ```tex fence opens before the tikzcd and is never closed (fence count is 1, odd), so the remainder of the block falls inside raw passthrough. (2) INTERNAL CONTRADICTION -- the prose says 'Photon absorption executes a Reidemeister I move on the trefoil embedding... This adds a curl at the exceptional divisor and increases the writhe by +2', while the display three lines later reads 'n -> n+1 <=> w -> w+2 <=> two R-I moves at exceptional divisor', and the sibling table hydrogen-orbital-tables lists '+2' R-I moves per unit shell. A single R-I move changes writhe by +/-1, so the singular 'a Reidemeister I move ... by +2' is the defective clause. Verified separately: Vol(Borromean) ~ 7.328 (correct, 7.3277247534); n = (w-1)/2 gives 1,2,3,4 for w = 3,5,7,9 (correct); sum_{l<n}(2l+1) = n^2 (correct); minimal trefoil writhe +3 (correct).

trap-em-dash.evidence: Three spaced em-dashes, all in the same three-item mode-gloss list ('Mode l = 0: Uniform (no oscillation) -- the s orbital', and likewise for p and d). trap-triples.evidence: The l = 0, 1, 2 list is a genuine enumeration truncated by an explicit '...' in the surrounding text, and each item carries distinct content (uniform / one wavelength / two wavelengths). Substantive enumeration, not a reflex triple.
